dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible along the mid-dorsal surface, characterized by sharp high-contrast outer perimeters that transition abruptly from a dark charcoal exterior to a light-grey interior. Some structures exhibit an interlocking 'figure-eight' geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, irregular light-intensity pixel clusters concentrated along the dorsal midline, becoming more dispersed and transitioning into annuli as they move towards the lateral flanks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent dorsal annuli form a non-linear, elongated zigzag pattern. A secondary cluster of three smaller blobs forms a distinct obtuse triangle near the posterior dorsal region.

other_distinctive_markers: The pattern exhibits a unique 'chain-link' effect where multiple macro-annuli overlap or share borders along the central lateral axis.
